resources.string: Grow crops and tend your orchard
Not enough coins. Choose a cheaper crop or harvest a ripe plant.
Remove this plant? The planting cost will be refunded.

Drag to explore and pinch to zoom. Overview shows all six fenced parcels. Tap a parcel sign to manage it.

Clear bushes, weeds and rocks with a quick tactile gesture: circle a finger around a rock to roll it away, or drag each weed sprig out one by one. Buy seeds from the shop, select your stock, then tap an empty space to plant.

To water, turn on watering mode with the can icon in the banner, tap a thirsty plant to raise its gauge, then tap again when the swinging marker sits in the highlighted zone. A few good hits in a row are needed; misses cost nothing, just try again. Growth continues while the app is closed.

To harvest, hold a ripe plant: it starts trembling and a small vertical gauge appears beside it, then drag your finger upward while the marker sits in the top band to pull it free and sell it.

Vegetables take 2–24 hours. Trees take 2–4 days for their first fruit, then 24 hours per harvest, after watering. Long press a plant to remove it and recover its purchase cost.

Unlock more parcels with coins. A parcel can become a vegetable garden or an orchard when it has no plants. Upgrade the watering can in the shop’s Bonuses tab to water a whole row, then a whole parcel at once. Livestock and fertilizer will come later.
Clear your first parcel. Buy seeds, plant, then water. Drag to explore; pinch to zoom.
For an orchard. First fruit after 2–4 days depending on the tree, then every 24 hours. Water after planting and after each harvest to start the next cycle.
For a vegetable garden. Water after planting to start growth. Harvesting sells the crop and frees the space.
Seeds added to your stock and selected. Tap a cleared space to plant.
Expand your farm with 12 new spaces to clear. You can use this parcel as a vegetable garden or an orchard.
New parcel unlocked. Clear the ground to start planting.
Livestock is not available yet: animal sprites and gameplay are still to be added.
Remove or harvest all plants before changing the parcel use.
Ground cleared. Select seeds and tap here to plant.
Trees need an orchard; other crops need a vegetable garden. Tap the parcel sign to change its use.
No seeds of this type. Buy some from the shop or select another crop in stock.
%1$s planted. Tap again to water and start growth.
Watered. Ready in %1$s, even while away.
Garden map. Drag to move, pinch to zoom. Tap a parcel to buy it, or its sign to access individual spaces.
A future premium upgrade will let you plant or harvest an entire parcel at once. It will be sold here for a large amount of coins. Not available to purchase yet.
Watering mode on. Tap a thirsty plant, then tap again when the marker hits the highlighted zone.
Nothing to water here. Turn off watering mode with the can icon to plant or harvest.
